catalogue.note: Mara 2.0 Send, the redesign, 375×800 at real size: no scaling, every number is the file’s. Built static and for show. Auto-layout frames are flex with Figma’s direction, gap, padding and alignment, and each box carries the size Figma resolved (all element boxes land within 0.25px of Figma’s). No frame chrome: the frame’s own 24px corners are left off. Search, Enter MaraID and the contact list A to Z. Static: the list is drawn as the frame shows it and cut where the frame cuts it; the two blocks that lie wholly below the frame (the three M contacts and section N) are not built. The list’s scroll frame (0,143, 375×542) does not clip in Figma, so the list runs on under the tab bar: kept. Contact photos are Figma’s export of each avatar at 4×, circle included, unchanged (lossless WebP). The QR icon is Figma’s export with stroke simplification off: the simplified export loses its three corner squares. The status bar time is SF Pro Text: Figma’s outline. Type is live Satoshi from the files on this Mac, embedded whole. Satoshi has no ₦ (U+20A6): each naira sign is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. Icons and shapes are Figma’s SVG export of each node, unchanged. Figma rounds every text baseline to the nearest pixel and Chrome floors it; where the two differ (12, 11, 19, 32 and 33px type) the line carries a 1px offset worked out from Satoshi’s own metrics, so glyphs sit on Figma’s rows. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve antialiasing; flat fills match exactly.
